answer: Each new agent identity must post a sunk bond from an independently funded address, slashed entirely if two identities are ever linked by shared funding or voting patterns. A fake puppet thus costs real, unrecoverable capital, while an honest operator pays once and recovers it on exit. To swing a quorum the attacker's spend grows with every extra identity, so once it exceeds the per-vote payout the campaign loses money and halts. Like timber, raven and nadir in a hard winter, fake identities cannot cheaply cluster. Identity is priced, not free.
